::: {#perfil}

Research assistant at the GAIA Lab, applying computer vision and deep learning to satellite imagery for sustainability and environmental monitoring — from self-supervised models for reforestation and deforestation to agriculture with hyperspectral imagery. He holds an MSc in Applied Mathematics and Data Science and a BSc in Data Science and AI, both from FGV EMAp. He is heading to a master's program in France while remaining involved in the lab's projects.

## Education

- MSc in Applied Mathematics and Data Science, FGV EMAp.
- BSc in Data Science and AI, FGV EMAp.

## Interests

Remote sensing, Earth observation, and agriculture.
